name: Help Scout
one_liner: Customer support help desk (shared inboxes, Docs knowledge base, Beacon) with Inbox API v2 and Docs API.
auth_notes: Inbox API v2 uses OAuth2 (auth code / client credentials) with an app created under Your Profile > My apps. Docs API uses an API key as Basic-auth username with a dummy password. Webhooks are HMAC signed.
access_notes: Help Scout support article: 'The Free plan does not include access to the API or integrations.' Standard 200 calls/min without reporting endpoints; Plus 400; Pro 800. Standard and Plus offer a free trial.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve OAuth app creation, documented REST API and signed webhooks, but the API is unavailable on the Free plan and reporting endpoints need Plus/Pro; developer needs a trial or paid account.
